method: Codex qualitative review with two Sol High read-only semantic packages. Same baseline rubric. Final [N] mapped through final sources[N-1] and chunk_id to full saved tool evidence; no repeated retrieval or judge API. Parent normalized no-fact clarification/canonical refusals to grounding=null.

rubric.correctness: 1=essential reference complete/correct;0.5=significant omission/minor factual error;0=core wrong or no requested answer
rubric.grounding: 1=all material claims supported by their actual cited fragments;0.5=minor inference/imprecision;0=material unsupported/generalized claim;null=no factual claim or canonical no-answer refusal
